items.body: Opening `/?species=unknown` throws from `presetById` inside the state initializer. There is no error boundary, so React leaves the viewer blank rather than displaying the required clear invalid-identity error.
items.suggestion: Validate query parameters before initializing the viewer and render an actionable error for unknown species. Add a browser regression for this URL.
items.title: Opening `/?species=unknown` throws from `presetById` inside the state initializer
